title: SessionAutoWakeOutlook.v1
description: Advisory broker snapshot of whether the recipient's idle auto-wake path is usable at checkedAt. It is not delivery, processing, completion, approval or permission evidence, and it never removes or re-sends a queued message.

state.description: available: a live relay can reserve a wake, or holds a current wake that is still inside its observation window. latched: an earlier wake that is not of the current generation, has passed its injection expiry, or was handed to the host more than 60 seconds ago without an observed hook arrival, is blocking a new wake; the recipient gets no new notification until its own next turn or tool boundary. no-live-relay: no online presence or relay lease can send a wake. unsupported: the recipient transport has no idle wake.

basisAt.description: Time of the stored fact behind reason: relay lease renewal, presence heartbeat when a relay lease is missing, wake injection expiry, retry deadline, presence lease end or birth. Null when no presence was ever recorded.
